[PREFERENCE] User decides to try the free version of Yoga Studio.  
[EVENT] User is experiencing back pain and asks if Yoga Studio has classes for that.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirms Yoga Studio has classes specifically designed for back pain, including Back Care classes.

[PREFERENCE] User plans to check out the Back Care section and start with gentle classes.
